title: C RPL: origin binding makes authorized DAOs effectively single-Target; multi-target staging paths are dead code for authorized traffic
description: Observation from reviewing 65ca175106 (spec-consistent, no defect): dao_targets_match_origin (rpl_dao_process.c:269-299) requires every Target to byte-equal the origin and duplicates are rejected downstream, so multi-Target DAO transactions are unreachable by authorized traffic; only single-target/multi-Transit grouping remains live (test_group_cartesian_and_path_control updated accordingly). This matches spec 8.7's .44.7 exactly-one-self-/128 profile. Action: annotate the now-dead multi-target staging paths so they are not read as live protocol behavior, or note them for the .44.9 generalized-profile work.
